blocks.html: Wherever an auxiliary inflation system is required, an approved standby power-generating system shall be provided. However, notwithstanding Section 2702.1, the standby power-generating system shall be equipped with a suitable means for automatically starting the generator set upon failure of the normal electrical service and for automatic transfer and operation of all of the required electrical functions at full power within 60 seconds of such service failure. Standby power shall be capable of operating independently for not less than 4 hours. Initiation of standby power shall be indicated by an audible and visual alert at the entrance or a regularly attended location.
